purpose: Test whether preserving the train-only physical residual distribution conditional on the local V14 backbone removes the V28/V29 tail explosion without A(k), clipping, or validation-target sampling.

train_only_fit.source_weight: exactly one third per source in every weighted empirical quantile
train_only_fit.backbone_coordinate: m=V14 corrected conditional_mean plus train-only predicted residual DC
train_only_fit.physical_residual: r=train truth y minus m, where y=log10(rho/box_mean)/4.5
train_only_fit.deterministic_voxel_lattice: for cube i use each axis offset ((i),(i//2),(i//4)) mod 2 and stride 2, yielding exactly 32^3 fit voxels per cube
train_only_fit.backbone_edges: equal-source weighted quantiles q=0,1/32,...,1 from deterministic train lattice values; strict monotonic repair by the next representable float

residual_quantile_levels.two_sided_tail: 10^x and 1-10^x for 1024 linearly spaced x from -7 to -1
residual_quantile_levels.combination: sorted unique union including exact 0 and 1

train_only_fit.per_backbone_bin_table: equal-source weighted physical-residual quantiles from the deterministic lattice
train_only_fit.tail_anchors: replace q=0 and q=1 in every backbone bin by the exact minimum and maximum from all train voxels in that bin
train_only_fit.monotonic_repair: cumulative maximum followed by nextafter for ties, using train-derived finite support only

conditional_transport.donor_forward: u=F_train(r_donor | m_donor) by piecewise-linear interpolation in the donor backbone bin
conditional_transport.orientation: apply the frozen V28 signed cube isometry to the complete u cube
conditional_transport.query_inverse: r_query=F_train^-1(u_oriented | m_query) by piecewise-linear interpolation in the query backbone bin
conditional_transport.dc_projection: subtract the transported query residual cube mean exactly
conditional_transport.sample: query V14 backbone m_query plus projected r_query

development_evaluation.paired_comparison: V28 and V29 with exact donor selections

fixed_branches.condition: field plus Q3/Q4 pass all three domains
fixed_branches.next: seal V31 and await explicit approval before Astrid

one real sample is finite and exact residual DC is below 1e-7
